anomalies.observed: The LDO output is on net +3.3V, but the separate +3V3 net contains MCU VBAT, pull-ups, and decoupling without any source. All FCC2 and NAVC2 VDD pins are explicitly on unconnected nets.
anomalies.expected: The 3.3 V rail from LD39200PU33R should feed both MCUs; FCC2/NAVC2 VDD pins should be connected to the 3V3 supply.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The MCU core supplies are not connected to the regulator output, so the FCC/NAVC MCUs and MCU-side pull-ups are unpowered and the board cannot boot or operate.

anomalies.observed: FCC2 VCAP power_out pins 48 and 73 are connected to UART3_FCC2 signal pins 3 and 4. No decoupling capacitors are present on the VCAP pins.
anomalies.expected: STM32H7 VCAP pins require local decoupling capacitors to GND and must not be tied to external UART connector signals.
anomalies.impact: Connecting a UART cable can short the MCU core regulator outputs to UART lines, and the missing VCAP decoupling can destabilize or damage the MCU.

anomalies.observed: The FCC HSE crystal is connected to FCC2 PE6/PE7 (pins 5 and 37) instead of PH0/PH1 (pins 12 and 13). The NAVC HSE crystal is not connected to NAVC2 PH0/PH1; those MCU oscillator pins only have load capacitors.
anomalies.expected: The specified 25 MHz HSE crystal should be connected across the MCU oscillator pins PH0/PH1 for both FCC and NAVC.

evidence.quote: HSE crystal (both MCUs) | FCC / NAVC | ABM8G-25.000MHZ-4Y-T3

anomalies.impact: The external 25 MHz clock is not correctly connected to the MCU oscillator inputs, so the MCUs may fail to run or run from an unintended clock source.
